summary: Preinstall dropper fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727 KB payload
details: The package declares itself as an ESLint configuration but ships a preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) that at `npm install` time downloads a Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts and chmods the `bun` binary in a temporary directory, and then invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` — a 727 KB single-line, obfuscator.io-style blob (hex-numeric string array, string-array rotator, custom-alphabet decoder function, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header). setup.mjs itself is obfuscated (`_0xXXXX` variable naming and string-lookup indirection) to conceal the URL construction and the `execFileSync(<bun>, ['math_init.js'],...)` invocation. Fetching an unrelated language runtime specifically to execute a bundled opaque script is unrelated to the declared ESLint-config purpose, deliberately bypasses Node-based static analysis (the true payload never executes under Node and is not readable), and runs automatically on every install. The behavior of the executed Bun payload cannot be determined from the shipped bytes.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
